objective: Prove the frozen statement: on the triangular lattice under NAE, pairs free, three-site bonds the triangles, the least bond through two sites at distance d of size d + 2, every bond native at the flat three-class state; finite checks against SAT on discs.
status: Proved 2026-11-11, refereed: on the triangular lattice under NAE (the ground states of the triangular Ising antiferromagnet), every pair is free and the non-free triples are exactly the triangles (R1); for two sites at graph distance d the least bond containing both has exactly d + 2 sites, one side of a triangle of side d with its opposite corner (R2); every site is flipped by a finite change at the flat three-class state (R3). Through the known height mapping and difference constraints; check.py passed (71,002 patterns against SAT, bonds to d = 8).
title: Bond distance is graph distance plus one in the plane
